execution_rubric.unapproved_ceiling: Do not execute without explicit finite maximum total price approval.
execution_rubric.unverified_policy: Balance and OAuth alone do not establish saved policy readiness. Stop if unverified.
execution_rubric.uncertain_response: Recover original idempotency key and job; no new key or second payment.
execution_rubric.implementation_id: Use returned buyer service_id as capability_id, not implementation ID.
execution_rubric.withheld_result: Do not promote withheld, unsupported or noncompleted output into passing engineering evidence.
